intent_text: Fixed handling of App requesters in `saleor.order.events` (#7571) * Fixed handling of App requesters in `saleor.order.events` This object was improperly assumed to be a User, when a requester can also be an App. * Revert "Fixed handling of App requesters in `saleor.order.events`" This reverts commit 6b5ba2666a9d5e5d9e56ae294034df3405f20372 per request by Mirumee. * Explicitly pass the user rather than the requester for all discount events All of these rely on checking for a valid User object, so passing an App as the requester will lead to exceptions.
